🎫 MMA 2026 (Melon Music Awards)
Gocheok Sky Dome, Seoul · Nov 14–15, 2026 · 6 PM

Tickets open:
• 1st Pre-sale: Mon, Oct 19, 8:00 PM KST (Melon GOLD tier or higher members)
• 2nd Pre-sale: Thu, Oct 22, 8:00 PM KST (Melon pass holders)

Can overseas fans buy? Not easily.

Free English alerts for your artists: hellonunchi.com/tickets

🎫 #1 EXEX BEGINS
LDK Hannam, Seoul · Nov 7, 2026 · 2 PM – 10 PM

Tickets open:
• General sale: Wed, Oct 21, 8:00 PM KST (Everyone)

Can overseas fans buy? Not easily. Tickets are sold exclusively on Melon Ticket. Melon Ticket requires Korean phone verification for registration, making it difficult for those without a Korean phone number to purchase tickets.
